svg.title: USDE's next open against the mark of Lighter's StablecoinX perp at 4 am and 9 am New York time, August 26 to October 8, 2026
svg.desc: Two scatter charts of the 30 stretches between a close and the next open. With the perp's mark at 4 am, the open sat nearer the mark than the prior close 17 times. With the mark at 9 am, 23 times. The largest move came over the weekend of September 19 and 20, when the mark sat 29% above Friday's close at 4 am on Monday and USDE opened 28% above it.
svg.text: By 9 am the perp’s mark was a closer guide to USDE’s next open than at 4 am
Each dot is one stretch from a close to the next open, August 26 to October 8, 2026. Each move runs from USDE’s prior close.
Open equal to the prior close
Perp’s mark at 4 am New York time
Perp’s mark against the prior close
